# oncallalert_escalation_policy (Resource)

An escalation policy and its ordered steps. Steps are notified in list order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oncallalert_escalation_policy" "primary" {
  name        = "Primary"
  description = "Page the on-call engineer, then the whole team"
  repeat      = 2

  steps = [
    {
      delay_minutes = 5
      actions = [
        { type = "builtin-rotation", args = { rotation_id = oncallalert_rotation.backend.id } },
      ]
    },
    {
      delay_minutes = 15
      actions = [
        { type = "builtin-schedule", args = { schedule_id = oncallalert_schedule.backend.id } },
        { type = "builtin-user", args = { user_id = data.oncallalert_user.lead.id } },
      ]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `repeat` (Number) How many times to repeat the steps if nobody acknowledges. Default 3.
- `steps` (Attributes List) Steps, in escalation order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned ID.

<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Required:

- `actions` (Attributes Set) Who or what to notify. `type` is a destination type such as `builtin-user` (args `user_id`), `builtin-rotation` (`rotation_id`), `builtin-schedule` (`schedule_id`), `builtin-slack-channel` (`slack_channel_id`) or `builtin-webhook` (`webhook_url`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps--actions))
- `delay_minutes` (Number) Minutes to wait before escalating to the next step.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Server-assigned step ID.

<a id="nestedatt--steps--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps.actions`

Required:

- `args` (Map of String)
- `type` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import oncallalert_escalation_policy.example <id>
```
